obligation: Prepare a clearly identifiable sustainability section in the statutory management report.
evidenceExpectation: Approved management-report template and published section
completionCriterion: Section approved, assured where required, and included in the statutory report.

obligation: Apply the legally applicable ESRS version and maintain a versioned requirement-to-disclosure mapping.
deadlineLogic: At reporting-cycle start and on standard change (see CSRD-S-012 selection)
completionCriterion: Applicable standard version and mapping approved.

obligation: Perform and approve the double-materiality process.
evidenceExpectation: DMA methodology, evidence, results and approvals
completionCriterion: Process approved and decision trail complete.

obligation: Document governance roles and an owned inventory of policies, actions, targets, metrics and data sources.
evidenceExpectation: RACI, board materials and policy/KPI inventory
completionCriterion: Named owners and source links exist.

obligation: Prepare linked EU Taxonomy Article 8 disclosures.
Appoint an eligible assurance provider, prepare evidence and obtain limited assurance.
deadlineLogic: Country-specific runway before the publication deadline
evidenceExpectation: Engagement letter, control evidence and assurance opinion

obligation: Inform and consult workers' representatives and communicate their opinion where applicable.
completionCriterion: Consultation evidence accepted; a recorded basis exists where the provision is not applicable.

obligation: Prepare the management report in the applicable electronic format.
evidenceExpectation: Validated digital output; do not assume sustainability tagging before the relevant tagging rules exist

obligation: Complete governance approval, filing, publication, language and accessibility steps.
evidenceExpectation: Board minutes, filing receipt and public URL

obligation: Document the FY2025–26 national transition determination and what work may safely stop or continue.
completionCriterion: Current cited decision communicated to stakeholders.

obligation: Maintain annual evidence supporting the subsidiary or higher-parent reporting exemption.
evidenceExpectation: Parent report, inclusion evidence, URL, assurance, taxonomy and language evidence

obligation: Prepare the Article 40a third-country sustainability report under the applicable standard.
deadlineLogic: Financial years beginning on/after 1 Jan 2028 and the applicable national calendar
evidenceExpectation: Group report and assurance evidence (N-ESRS under development — see CW-004)
completionCriterion: Compliant report supplied to the gateway.

obligation: Publish and make accessible the third-country report through the qualifying EU subsidiary or branch.
Map and respond to the CSRD value-chain information request item by item.
evidenceExpectation: Request mapping and approved response basis
completionCriterion: Response sent with voluntary/declined items recorded.

obligation: Identify above-cap items and notify the protected undertaking of its right to decline (requestor-side duty).
Explain unavailable value-chain information, efforts and future plans during the transition period.
Operate an evidence registry linking obligations to proof, owners, source locations, freshness and acceptance.
evidenceExpectation: Evidence registry records — never mandatory file custody
completionCriterion: Critical evidence is current and accepted.
